title: Assistant Professor of Economics and Public Policy
description:
Assistant Professor of Economics and Public Policy

 

The Cornell Jeb E. Brooks School of Public Policy and the Department of Economics jointly invite applications for a tenure-track position at the rank of Assistant Professor of Economics and Public Policy. We seek economists whose research engages with either of two broadly defined areas: (1) data science and/or technology policy or (2) environmental and/or sustainability policy. The successful candidate will receive appointments in both the Department of Economics and the Brooks School of Public Policy.

 

Data science and/or technology policy: We welcome economists who: (1) develop data science methods with applications to public policy; or (2) use frontier data science methods or novel forms of data to address policy relevant economic questions; or (3) study the economic and policy implications of artificial intelligence, algorithms, digital platforms, or other emerging technologies. Such research may advance data science methods, deepen our understanding of economic effects of new methods and technologies, or inform policy design and regulation of emerging technologies.

 

Environmental and/or sustainability policy: We welcome economists studying topics such as environmental quality, climate change, energy markets and the energy transition, environmental regulation, natural resources, pollution, sustainability, and other related topics. Research should inform the understanding, design, or evaluation of environmental policy.

 

Candidates in either category may use a range of theoretical or empirical approaches and should demonstrate promise for excellence in research and teaching. The successful candidate will contribute to teaching and advising in both economics and public policy at the undergraduate and graduate levels, including courses related to the candidate's area of expertise. Candidates must have received a Ph.D. in Economics, Public Policy, or a related field by July 2027.

 

In compliance with New York’s Pay Transparency Law, the annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 - $185,000. Cornell University considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and organizational considerations when extending an offer.

 

Consistent with Cornell’s practice, appointments to academic positions require candidates to disclose relevant information about their prior employment including whether they have been found to have violated institutional or employer policies related to or governing unlawful discrimination and harassment, academic and research misconduct, or financial misconduct.

 

We will begin to review applications starting November 9, 2026, and will continue until the search is complete. To guarantee full consideration, your file should be complete by this date. Cornell has historical commitment to pursuing knowledge for “…any person…in any study”, and welcomes students, faculty and staff from all walks of life.

 

The Cornell Jeb E. Brooks School of Public Policy was established in 2021 to tackle the most pressing policy challenges we face in the U.S. and globally. To advance this goal, we are hiring world-class research scholars across many disciplines who are oriented toward policy engagement and impact. More information appears at https://www.publicpolicy.cornell.edu/

 

Application Information:  Interested applicants should submit a curriculum vitae, three letters of recommendation, samples of written work, research statement, and teaching statement.

 

Information about the Economics Department appears at https://www.economics.cornell.edu.

 

Questions about the position and the search can be sent to the search committee chair, Amanda Agan, amanda.agan@cornell.edu.

 

Applicants must submit materials through academicjobsonline.org: https://academicjobsonline.org/ajo/jobs/32819
